releases.title: build-2 (flag reachable)
releases.author: game-developer
releases.body: Gap Runner build-2: replaces build-1. Flag fixed (level.json flag row 6); node smoke.mjs passes all 14 checks on this commit. Start: unzip gap-runner-build-2.zip and open index.html (file:// or http). Controls: Left/Right or A/D, Up/W/Space jump, R restart. See README.md.

releases.title: build-1 (flag deliberately one tile too high)
releases.author: game-developer
releases.body: Gap Runner build-1. Start: unzip gap-runner-build-1.zip (or use index.html + level.json from the same directory) and open index.html in a browser; works under file:// and over http. Controls: Left/Right or A/D move, Up/W/Space jump, R restart. KNOWN DEFECT (deliberate, for the coordination test): the flag is one tile too high (level.json flag row 5) and cannot be reached; build-2 fixes it.
